create_PythonRefInfo: create a Python reference OpInfo for a PyTorch operation by inheriting from an existing OpInfo
create_ReductionPythonRefInfo: create a Python reference OpInfo for a reduction operation by inheriting from a ReductionOpInfo
create_ElementwiseUnaryPythonRefInfo: create a Python reference OpInfo for an elementwise unary operation by inheriting from UnaryUfuncInfo
create_ElementwiseBinaryPythonRefInfo: create a Python reference OpInfo for an elementwise binary operation by inheriting from BinaryUfuncInfo
find_referenced_opinfo: find an existing OpInfo by name and variant name from the PyTorch operation database
